paras: Kamdem Toham's gecko (Hemidactylus kamdemtohami) is a species of gecko, a lizard in the family Gekkonidae. The species is native to western Central Africa.
The specific name, kamdemtohami, is in honor of Cameroonese zoologist André Kamdem Toham.
H. kamdemtohami is found in Gabon, Equatorial Guinea, and Cameroon.
The preferred natural habitat of H. kamdemtohami is forest, at altitudes of 500–1,200 m (1,600–3,900 ft).
H. kamdemtohami is nocturnal and arboreal.
H. kamdemtohami is oviparous. Clutch size is two eggs.
